name: Simulators
description: iOS simulators and Android emulators of the agents' own, one thread's each, slim: about a third of the memory, so more of them run at once. Screenshots, touches, apps and device settings through tools, live in Swarm's window.

settings.title: iOS simulators for agents
settings.description: How many the agents may run at once, a thread's each (about 1 GB each slim, 3 GB stock). 0: none.

settings.title: Android emulators for agents
settings.description: How many the agents may run at once, a thread's each (about 2.5 GB each slim, 8 GB stock). 0: none.

settings.title: Android emulators' memory
settings.description: Each emulator's RAM in MB: an app under test needs room. Applied as each next boots.

settings.title: Slim simulators
settings.description: Run the agents' simulators with what they rarely need turned off: on iOS, Siri, Spotlight, widgets, iCloud, photo analysis and more (simslim's lists); on Android, Google's apps and services, sync and background processes (avdslim's). Applied as each next boots. Never the user's own simulators.

settings.title: Keep in iOS simulators
settings.description: What slimming leaves on: category ids (swarm simulators slimming lists them) or single launchd labels. The default keeps push and StoreKit, universal links, iCloud and HealthKit.

settings.title: Keep in Android emulators
settings.description: What slimming leaves on: category ids (swarm simulators slimming lists them) or single packages.

settings.title: iOS model
settings.description: The model agents' simulators are made of. Empty: the newest iPhone Pro of the newest iOS.

settings.title: Mac
settings.description: The Mac the iOS simulators run on: one joined to Swarm (its name), or an ssh target. Empty: this computer where it's a Mac, else the first Mac joined to Swarm.

settings.title: Android emulators' computer
settings.description: Where the Android emulators run: a computer joined to Swarm, or an ssh target. Empty: where the iOS simulators run.

settings.title: Android SDK
settings.description: The SDK's folder there. Empty: $ANDROID_HOME, Android Studio's, Homebrew's, or bb's Simulator plugin's, the first with an emulator.

settings.title: Android system image
settings.description: What agents' emulators are made of. Empty: the newest Google APIs image installed.

tools.name: sim_status
tools.title: Simulators' status
tools.description: The agents' iOS simulators and Android emulators: each one, who has it, how it is, who waits. Never waits.

tools.name: sim_take
tools.title: Take a simulator
tools.description: Take an iOS simulator or Android emulator of your own, a fresh one of the plugin's (none of the user's apps or data), made, slimmed and booted as needed: its name and UDID or adb serial, to build and install for. Yours alone until your turn of the conversation ends. Every other sim_* tool takes one by itself; take first to build for it.

platform.description: ios (an iOS simulator) or android (an Android emulator). Left out: the one you hold, else ios.

note.description: What you're testing, shown to the user.

wait.description: Minutes to wait in line when every agent simulator of the platform is another thread's (default 4; 0 not to wait).

tools.name: sim_release
tools.title: Give a simulator back
tools.description: Give your simulator back now (both when no platform is named). Your turn ending gives it back anyway; the same thread gets it back as it left it if nobody took it.

platform.description: ios (an iOS simulator) or android (an Android emulator). Left out: the one you hold, else ios.

tools.name: sim_capture
tools.title: Screenshot your simulator
tools.description: A screenshot of your simulator's screen, at its pixels, which sim_drive takes. show: also give a Markdown image line to put in your reply, which shows it in the thread.

platform.description: ios (an iOS simulator) or android (an Android emulator). Left out: the one you hold, else ios.

show.description: Show it to the user: a Markdown image line for your reply.

wait.description: Minutes to wait in line when every agent simulator of the platform is another thread's (default 4; 0 not to wait).

tools.name: sim_describe
tools.title: Read your simulator's screen
tools.description: Your simulator's screen as named elements (buttons, fields, cells, text) and the point to tap each, in screenshot pixels: cheaper and surer than a screenshot to find where to tap. iOS through WebDriverAgent (a few minutes to build the first time), Android through uiautomator.

platform.description: ios (an iOS simulator) or android (an Android emulator). Left out: the one you hold, else ios.

wait.description: Minutes to wait in line when every agent simulator of the platform is another thread's (default 4; 0 not to wait).

tools.name: sim_drive
tools.title: Drive your simulator
tools.description: Taps, swipes, keys and text on your simulator, in screenshot pixels, one step per entry: tap X Y, long X Y [MS], swipe X1 Y1 X2 Y2 [MS], type TEXT, key NAME (iOS: home, enter, lock, volumeup, volumedown; Android: home, back, enter, recents, delete, tab, power), wait MS. capture: a screenshot after.

platform.description: ios (an iOS simulator) or android (an Android emulator). Left out: the one you hold, else ios.

capture.description: Return a screenshot after the steps.

wait.description: Minutes to wait in line when every agent simulator of the platform is another thread's (default 4; 0 not to wait).

tools.name: sim_app
tools.title: An app on your simulator
tools.description: List the installed apps, or launch, terminate, install (an .app, .ipa or .apk: a path on your own computer, copied over, or on the simulators' computer), uninstall an app, open a URL or deep link (openurl), or read an app's recent logs.

platform.description: ios (an iOS simulator) or android (an Android emulator). Left out: the one you hold, else ios.

target.description: Bundle id or package; a path for install; a URL for openurl.

wait.description: Minutes to wait in line when every agent simulator of the platform is another thread's (default 4; 0 not to wait).

tools.name: sim_device
tools.title: Your simulator itself
tools.description: Change your simulator: appearance (dark|light), text-size (iOS: extra-small … accessibility-extra-extra-extra-large; Android: a font scale, 1.3), location (LAT,LON, or clear), permission (grant|revoke|reset SERVICE, with app), push (the payload's JSON, with app; iOS), status-bar (clean, or clear). Or shutdown, reboot, erase (no apps, no data), measure (its memory).

platform.description: ios (an iOS simulator) or android (an Android emulator). Left out: the one you hold, else ios.

app.description: The app's bundle id or package, for permission and push.

wait.description: Minutes to wait in line when every agent simulator of the platform is another thread's (default 4; 0 not to wait).

tools.name: sim_shell
tools.title: A command on your simulator
tools.description: Run a shell command on your own simulator and get its output and exit code. Android: in the emulator's shell (root: true runs it as root through su, which keeps adb and your forwards as they are, unlike adb root); sqlite3, pm, am, settings, logcat, cmd and the rest. iOS: on the Mac, in the simulator's data folder, with $UDID and $DATA set: xcrun simctl … $UDID, sqlite3 on an app's database (xcrun simctl get_app_container $UDID BUNDLE data).

platform.description: ios (an iOS simulator) or android (an Android emulator). Left out: the one you hold, else ios.

wait.description: Minutes to wait in line when every agent simulator of the platform is another thread's (default 4; 0 not to wait).

tools.name: sim_files
tools.title: Copy files to or from your simulator
tools.description: Copy a file between your own computer (where you build; local, absolute) and your simulator (remote), wherever the simulators run. Android: a path on the device (outside /sdcard and /data/local/tmp as root). iOS: app:BUNDLE/path in that app's data container, or a path in the simulator's data folder.

platform.description: ios (an iOS simulator) or android (an Android emulator). Left out: the one you hold, else ios.

wait.description: Minutes to wait in line when every agent simulator of the platform is another thread's (default 4; 0 not to wait).

tools.name: sim_forward
tools.title: Reach your dev server from your simulator
tools.description: Make your simulator's localhost:port reach your dev server (Metro, a web server) on your own computer, wherever the simulators run: to is host:port or a port there (port when left out). Android through adb reverse, kept across the emulator's reboots; an iOS simulator shares its Mac's network. No port: lists your forwards. remove: undoes one (or all). They go when your simulator goes to another thread.

platform.description: ios (an iOS simulator) or android (an Android emulator). Left out: the one you hold, else ios.

to.description: host:port, or a port on your computer.

wait.description: Minutes to wait in line when every agent simulator of the platform is another thread's (default 4; 0 not to wait).
